description: This file defines an abstract class implementing statistical regression analysis, specifically for fitting and analyzing best-fit lines like linear regression within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: BestFit
classes.description: An abstract class representing a general approach to calculating and analyzing best-fit regression lines, including methods for retrieving regression parameters and goodness-of-fit metrics.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the indicator flag for a calculation error.

methods.name: getBestFitType
methods.description: Returns the type of regression algorithm used.

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope of the best-fit line, rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: getSlopeSE
methods.description: Returns the standard error of the slope, rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Returns the X value where the regression line intersects Y=0.

methods.name: getIntersectSE
methods.description: Returns the standard error of the intercept.

methods.name: getGoodnessOfFit
methods.description: Returns the goodness-of-fit metric for the regression.

methods.name: getStdevOfResiduals
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the residuals.

methods.name: getSSRegression
methods.description: Returns the sum of squares due to regression.

methods.name: getSSResiduals
methods.description: Returns the sum of squares of residuals.

methods.name: getDFResiduals
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom for residuals.

methods.name: getCovariance
methods.description: Returns the covariance of the data.

methods.name: getYBestFitValues
methods.description: Returns the Y-values predicted by the best-fit line.
